title: Adaptive Differential Evolution and Multistart Search for Noisy QAOA Optimization
summary: We benchmark classical optimization of a fixed low-depth Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) ansatz across four cost-Hamiltonian families at $N=12$, $p=3$, and $D=6$. Ten optimizers are compared over 25 independent runs under common ceilings of 10\,000 and 30\,000 function evaluations (FEs), first with exact statevector objectives and then with two additive observation-noise levels. Exact objectives favor multistart BFGS and multistart CMA-ES.
